slides.heading: Fire Safety Crisis in Wang Fuk Court
slides.text: A year after the deadliest fire in Hong Kong, families are still waiting for justice.

slides.heading: Fire Safety Issues
slides.text: The fire safety issues faced by residents in Wang Fuk Court, a residential complex in Hong Kong, have led to a year-long investigation and a call for reforms.

slides.heading: Fire Safety Failures
slides.text: The fire safety failures, including the use of foam boards to block daylight and the installation of protective mesh nets and bamboo scaffolding, have been identified as contributing factors to the fire.
